examples.name: Sample — block-picture-boundary
paragraphs: Pale beige = Picture · orange = Caption · yellow = Text. Example A is a storage diagram whose bold line Storage nodes with mixed client hosts is drawn inside the graphic, so the correct box (✓) is one Picture that includes it; the ✗ box splits it off as a Caption. Example B is a bar chart: the correct box (✓) is one Picture that includes the rotated Precision axis title, the tick labels and the Dataset axis title; the ✗ box clips the plot area and files the two axis titles as Text and Caption. Expected boxes: one Picture per example, nothing else.
The bars print no values; the values above are read against the printed 0.55–0.85 axis.

examples.name: Sample — block-picture-grouping
paragraphs: Pale beige = Picture · orange = Caption · red = Section-header · yellow = Text. Two columns of an article. Four chart panels (a)–(d) above FIG. 3. form one Picture; two panels (a)–(b) above FIG. 4. form a second. Each caption is its own element. Expected boxes, left column then right: Picture, Caption, Section-header, Text; Picture, Caption, Text, Text, Text. The overlay tints the text; it is transcribed from the page source. The chart content of the two Pictures prints no values and is elided.

FIG. 3. (a) Mean passage time $$\tau$$ and (b) its spread $$\sigma$$ as a function of the bias for the walkers A, B and C. (c) Variance of the escape time; the inset shows the peak region. (d) Second-passage probability for the same three walkers, plotted against the rescaled distance.
C. Coarse chain It is a coarse-grained model of a short chain. The model is of higher complexity than the walkers used in the previous section, having rougher free-energy landscapes and several stable states.
FIG. 4. (a) Free-energy map over the two angles; the metastable states are marked by dots. (b) Transition rate $$\kappa$$ against temperature for the forward and reverse bias.
the external forces are chosen to test the effectiveness of the reweighting procedure for conservative and non-conservative forces. The free-energy map is shown in Figure 4a using the two angles as coordinates. Three metastable states were identified, representing the folded state, the unfolded state and an intermediate state. The dynamics is typically metastable, as the states lie in separate basins, and the intermediate state is placed slightly to the right of the middle. Second, we apply a non-conservative force along the chain. A force of this size keeps the system in equilibrium; on the other hand, we can also drive it out of equilibrium into a NESS along the chain.

examples.name: Sample — block-table-structure
paragraphs: Pink = Table · red = Section-header · yellow = Text. A three-row grid inside a frame that continues down around the notes below it. Expected boxes: one Table that stops after the grid's last row, then five Text elements and one Section-header (IMPORTANT!) for the framed prose. The deadline cell is printed bold in red; the colour is emphasis and is not carried.
